@graph.name: EarlyJobs Salary Benchmarking & Compensation Planning Tool
@graph.description: Interactive planner that calculates monthly and annual compensation budgets from employer-provided salary, headcount and optional comparison inputs.

acceptedAnswer.text: Salary benchmarking compares compensation for similar roles using consistent assumptions — base pay, location, level, and headcount. The EarlyJobs Salary Benchmarking Planner helps Indian employers model hiring budgets across teams before approvals, without relying on unverified market claims.

mainEntity.name: Does the tool provide live market salary data?

acceptedAnswer.text: This planner uses salary scenarios and figures you enter, not a live national wage database. Pair it with the Salary Benchmarking Tool for reference ranges, then plug verified numbers from your own surveys or finance here for budget planning.

mainEntity.name: Can employers compare salary budgets across locations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Enter separate pay assumptions for metros, tier-2 cities, or multiple plants. The planner rolls up totals so workforce planning and TA leaders see how location mix affects annual hiring spend.

mainEntity.name: Is the Salary Benchmarking Planner free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. EarlyJobs offers the Salary Benchmarking Planner free online. Use it with the free Salary Benchmarking Tool when preparing compensation bands for manufacturing, healthcare, or high-volume hiring programs.
